items.rationale: Remains of insured site installation, material arising under 5.2.1(a); fair disposal price for timber load.
Glass pane is a building component of the shed; remains covered under 5.2.1(a); small disposal charge.
Storm-felled vegetal material is material arising under 5.2.1(b) and 2.5.3(c); ordinary green waste disposal price.

items.description: Disposal of tree root ball under 1 m3
items.rationale: Single root mass not exceeding one cubic metre counts as material arising under 5.2.1(b); covered.
Ground material however processed is excluded under 5.2.1(d) and 4.3(d); no reinstatement ground works or making good, so 5.2.2 not met.
Paving grit is ground material; standalone disposal without making good is not indemnified under 5.2.1(d)/5.2.2.
Excavated soil is ground material; clearance standing on its own, no foundation or reinstatement work, excluded under 5.2.2 last paragraph.
